target.title: fix(compaction): count nested tool result content
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99375.

Fixes an issue where users in tool-heavy Codex sessions could see compaction repeatedly retain the full transcript when recent context was dominated by Codex tool-result blocks. Those blocks were preserved in transcript content as nested `toolResult` payloads, but the compaction estimator did not count their text, so the cut point could collapse back to the start of the transcript.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared compaction estimator now counts nested `toolResult`/`tool_result` text payloads in the same content-block pass that already accounts for text and image blocks. This keeps the fix at the compaction accounting boundary instead of adding Codex-specific policy or changing compaction thresholds.

Dependency contract checked against OpenAI Codex protocol sources in sibling `../codex`: `codex-rs/protocol/src/items.rs` for tool-call/result item shapes and `codex-rs/protocol/src/dynamic_tools.rs` for dynamic tool output content items.

## User Impact

Tool-heavy Codex conversations can choose a real compaction cut point instead of no-oping when the newest retained transcript contains nested tool-result output. Text and image accounting behavior is unchanged for existing transcript shapes.

## Evidence

- Red first: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction-trailing-toolresult.test.ts` failed before the implementation because the new nested `toolResult` case estimated `0` tokens and retained entry index `0`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction-trailing-toolresult.test.ts` (4 passed)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction-image-tokens.test.ts` (3 passed)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/transcript-file-state.test.ts` (25 passed)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction-trailing-toolresult.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction-image-tokens.test.ts` (7 passed)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction-trailing-toolresult.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

Known local proof gap: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.context-engine.test.ts` was attempted, but this local Windows worktree does not have the `codex-context-test-sandbox` backend registered. The run failed before exercising this compaction change, with `turn/start` not observed and an unhandled sandbox backend registration error.
